fact: Xaniko 警告 Daley：若违命就把他和他的监护人（Vedra）一起从前门赶出去，Daley 只得答应服从。
anchor: I will put you and your guardian out the front door without hesitation

fact: Vedra 讲述天赋来历：预言之梦自幼而来，她因触碰父亲的手而看出父亲与邻家女人有染，说破后父亲开始设法把她送出家门。
anchor: her gifts had first come to her in dreams, dreams which often came true

fact: Xaniko 交给 Vedra 一面普通的抛光青铜镜（象牙柄）作占卜工具，说这并非受咒的 Witness。
anchor: a simple polished bronze mirror with an ivory handle

fact: Vedra 在镜中看见海边一名披斗篷的银发女人，眼睛是猫一样的黄色，那女人朝她说了一句“Din so-nosa beya Vao-ya ulluru.”
anchor: her shockingly yellow eyes roved as though they could not find her

fact: Xaniko 说镜中所见是他的妻子 Ona，她已经死了几百年（hundreds of mortal years）。
anchor: That was my wife Ona that you saw, who has been dead for hundreds of mortal years

fact: Xaniko 警告梦境之路（Yumamiji／Dream Road）的危险：走得够远，所见会比记忆更真实，人会永远迷失。
anchor: the things you see become more real than the things you remember

fact: 管家 Mollie 说宅中住着二十七人（随即改口二十八人），除三人外全是当年随 Xaniko 从 Ravensperch 来的仆役后代，她的曾曾祖父就是其中之一。
anchor: Of the twenty-seven of us who live here

fact: Daley 伸手去碰架上亡妻 Ona 的遗物却什么也摸不到——Xaniko 说那些东西被“保存之歌”置于时间之外；他逼 Daley 以母亲的灵魂起誓不碰藏书。
anchor: you could reach for a thousand years and never touch them
